ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75:25 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels across the visible ventral surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white regions dominate the lateral and distal portions of both lobes. Low-intensity black pigmentation is concentrated at the proximal base near the notch and along the leading edges, with significant stochastic mottling and speckling on the inner half of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with an approximate pixel angle of 48 degrees and a narrow vertex depth relative to the fluke width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge; notable high-amplitude jagged peaks (approximately 10-15 pixels in depth) located near the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave curve fitted to the trailing edges, sweeping upward and outward toward sharp distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Concentrated high-relief textured clusters at both lobe tips; multiple small, dark, circular pixel clusters scattered across the white field of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A distinct vertical dark linear disruption approximately 1/4 the height of the left lobe; several smaller horizontal scratches visible on the upper-mid section of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive calcareous growth/barnacle colonization visible as high-intensity, rough-textured masses at the distal tips of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Partial occlusion of the lower-medial section of the right lobe by water spray and high-intensity specular glare.
